lines.en: Sibilant hiss, moves slowly.

lines.zh: 影子般的脚步，无声无息。
lines.en: Silent, shadowy footsteps.
Ice-cold touch, slow movement.
Silent, dark gliding.
Chill, slowly approaching.
Shadows distort, chase prey.

lines.zh: 蠕动着接近，如同活体阴影。
lines.en: Creeping closer, living shadow.
Fuzzy outline in shadows.

lines.zh: 漆黑中缓慢移动的阴影。
lines.en: Slowly moving shadow in darkness.

lines.zh: 如同死亡般寒冷的气息。
lines.en: Deathly cold breaths.
Sliding out of a cave fissure.
Inching forward along the mine shaft.
Stays still, lurking in darkness.
Gazes ahead, waiting patiently.
Motionless, hidden deep.
Silent, hiding threats.
Slight movement in shadows.
Lurking in shadows, waiting.
Silently hidden, waiting.
Still shadow, lurking silently.
Silent guardian in darkness.
Motionless, like a shadow.
Motionless deep in the mine.

lines.zh: 数着你的火把，等它熄灭。
lines.en: Counting your torch, waiting for it to go out.
Pressed to the cave wall, melting into the rock shadow.

lines.zh: 已在地下待了数个昼夜。
lines.en: It has waited underground for several days.
Locks onto player, sharp gaze.
Staring, intense gaze.
Fixing gaze on player, unwavering.
Gaze flickers, locking target.

lines.zh: 目光如炬，盯着玩家不放。
lines.en: Intense stare, unyielding.
Stare at player, relentless.
Intensely staring, unwavering.
Gaze like a knife, locking player.
Sharp gaze, on player.
Stare at player, unblinking.

lines.zh: 你每下一层，它就看一次。
lines.en: Each level you descend, it looks once.
Counting your breaths in the dark.
It pushes you back with its stare alone.
An eye opens on the cave wall.
Staring straight from behind a stalactite.
The longer it stares, the faster it grows.
It neither blinks nor makes a sound.

lines.zh: 在火光边缘盯着你的背。
lines.en: Watching your back beyond the torchlight.

lines.zh: 把你的影子看得越来越长。
lines.en: Watching your shadow stretch longer.
It looks down at you from the cave ceiling.

lines.zh: 扭曲的眼球滴着血，你感到一阵寒意。
lines.en: Its distorted eye oozes blood, sending shivers down your spine.

lines.zh: 这黏糊糊的生物在你身边蠕动，让你胆战心惊。
lines.en: The slimy creature squirms near you, sending chills through you.

lines.zh: 它腐烂的触手缠住了你的脚踝，你拼命挣扎。
lines.en: Its rotting tentacles wrap around your ankle, making you struggle.

lines.zh: 这恶心的生物发出嘶嘶声，逼近你。
lines.en: The disgusting creature hisses, creeping closer to you.

lines.zh: 它的触手撕裂你的皮肤，你感到剧痛。
lines.en: Its tentacles tear through your skin, causing intense pain.

lines.zh: 那黏滑的感觉让你胃里翻江倒海。
lines.en: The slimy sensation makes your stomach churn.

lines.zh: 这邪恶的生物用触手缠住你，你无法呼吸。
lines.en: The evil creature wraps you in its tentacles, making it hard to breathe.

lines.zh: 它扭曲的身体挤压着你，疼痛难忍。
lines.en: Its twisted body compresses you, causing excruciating pain.

lines.zh: 这怪物的叫声让你毛骨悚然。
lines.en: Its chilling call sends shivers down your spine.

lines.zh: 它腐烂的肢体粘附在你身上，令人作呕。
lines.en: Its rotting limbs adhere to you, making you sick

lines.zh: 你手中的光亮如同猎物，我将享受这场盛宴。
lines.en: Your light is prey, and I will feast on it.

lines.zh: 我等待着你的错误，然后吞噬你的灵魂。
lines.en: I wait for your mistake, then consume your soul.

lines.zh: 你的恐惧让我兴奋，快点向我靠近。
lines.en: Your fear excites me, come closer.

lines.zh: 不要试图逃出我的视线，你会成为我的晚餐。
lines.en: Don't try to escape my sight, you'll be my meal.

lines.zh: 靠近我，让我品尝你的体温。
lines.en: Come to me, let me taste your warmth.

lines.zh: 你的每一次心跳都在诱惑我。
lines.en: Your every heartbeat tempts me.
You can't escape my cave.

lines.zh: 我的触感会带你进入深渊。
lines.en: My touch will take you to the depths.

lines.zh: 你将成为我进化的一部分。
lines.en: You'll be part of my evolution.
I will turn you into energy.

lines.zh: 你的入侵打扰了我的领地。
lines.en: Your intrusion disturbs my territory.

lines.zh: 你挡了我的路，必须除去。
lines.en: You block my path, must be removed.

lines.zh: 你的存在威胁着我的生存。
lines.en: Your presence threatens my survival.

lines.zh: 避让开，否则我会迫击你。
lines.en: Move, or I'll attack.

lines.zh: 你挡住了我的视线，我要清理障碍。
lines.en: You block my sight, I'll clear the obstruction.

lines.zh: 我的触角会吞噬一切障碍。
lines.en: My tendrils will consume all obstacles.
You block my way.
Your interference must end.

lines.zh: 你的存在是对我的挑衅。
lines.en: Your existence is a provocation.

lines.zh: 我要将你从我领地中清除。
lines.en: I'll clear you from my territory.
The scent of a mate attracts me.

lines.zh: 寻找另一个同类很重要。
lines.en: Finding another of my kind is important.

lines.zh: 我们需要繁衍，继续种族。
lines.en: We need to reproduce, continue the race.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣会在黑暗中等待。
lines.en: My mate waits in the dark.

lines.zh: 找到我的同类，一起繁衍。
lines.en: Find my mate, reproduce together.

lines.zh: 同类的吸引是不可抗拒的。
lines.en: The attraction to a mate is irresistible.

lines.zh: 我需要一个伴侣来繁衍。
lines.en: I need a mate to reproduce.
My mate is nearby.
Reproduction is the only way out.

lines.zh: 找到我的同类，共同繁衍。
lines.en: Find my mate, reproduce together.

lines.zh: 你感觉有什么东西在注视你！
lines.en: You feel something staring at you!

lines.zh: 这洞穴深处有什么不对劲！
lines.en: Something's off in this cave!

lines.zh: 它的目光犹如深渊般深邃！
lines.en: Its gaze is as deep as a void.

lines.zh: 你的每一寸皮肤都在战栗！
lines.en: Every inch of your skin is trembling!

lines.zh: 它的眼睛如同漆黑的洞穴！
lines.en: Its eyes are like black caverns.

lines.zh: 你仿佛能听到它的呼吸！
lines.en: You can almost hear its breath.

lines.zh: 你的心跳声在它的注视下显得微不足道！
lines.en: Your heartbeat is insignificant under its gaze.

lines.zh: 它的目光中充满了无尽的贪婪！
lines.en: Its gaze is filled with endless greed.

lines.zh: 它仿佛可以看透你的灵魂！
lines.en: It seems to see right through your soul.

lines.zh: 你的每一个动作都在它的视野中！
lines.en: Every move of yours is within its sight.
Your scent draws it in!
It has locked onto your position!
Its presence excites it!
It begins to track you!
You're its prey!
Its attention is drawn to you!

lines.zh: 它的目光锁定在你身上！
lines.en: Its gaze is fixed on you!
It's ready to hunt!
You are its target!
Its desires drive it to action!
It has memorized your footsteps.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处，我一直在看火光。
lines.en: Deep in the cave, I watch the torchlight.
The eye on the wall has moved.
The underground silence is broken.

lines.zh: 它从钟乳石间爬了下来。
lines.en: It climbs down among the stalactites.
It has remembered your name.
Its fangs glint with cold!
Its claws are ready to tear you!
Its eyes burn with desire!
Its tentacles reach for you!
Its body circles around you!
It's ready to consume you!
Its power makes you tremble!
Its roar shakes the ground!
It wants your blood!

lines.zh: 它的呼吸带有死亡的气息！
lines.en: Its breath is filled with death!
Its stare thickens into real pressure.
It counts the gaps between your heartbeats.

lines.zh: 洞壁开始向你这侧倾斜。
lines.en: The cave walls begin to lean toward you.
Its outline is larger than last time.
Shadows close in from every side.

lines.zh: 它在等你踩空的那一步。
lines.en: It waits for the step you misjudge.
Whispers seep out of the fissures.
Eyes open one layer after another.

lines.zh: 你的火把在它注视下变暗。
lines.en: Your torch dims under its gaze.
It has already evolved once.
What do you smell?
Your flesh is useful to me.

lines.zh: 我从洞顶垂下来，碰到你。
lines.en: I hang down from the ceiling and touch you.
Taste my fangs.
Your suffering is about to end.
Don't try to escape.
You can't defeat me.
My strength surpasses yours.
You are just my meal.
Enjoy your doom.

lines.zh: 岩壁里伸出的手抓住你。
lines.en: A hand from the wall grabs you.
It bites into the glow of your torch.
Sharp as shattered rock.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，石壁都在发凉。
lines.en: I stare, and the stone walls go cold.
It tears the seam of your armor.

lines.zh: 你听见自己的骨头在响。
lines.en: You hear your own bones creak.
New prey has appeared.
They went underground.
Prepare for fear.
A new soul.
My cave will consume them.
They will be my dinner.
Now, they belong to me.
I watch over them.
Fear has come.
They don't know danger.

lines.zh: 三个月前的种子长成了。
lines.en: A seed planted months ago has grown.

lines.zh: 它选择在第十四天醒来。
lines.en: It chooses to wake on the fourteenth day.
Something stirs at the end of the tunnel.
A second breath joins the underground.
The cave darkness thickens a shade.
It climbs up from the deepest place.
Your mine is no longer quiet.
A crack in the rock opens like an eyelid.
It opens its eyes beneath your feet.
A pulse sounds inside the deep rock.

lines.zh: 它的触手被火焰烧焦，痛苦地嘶叫着。
lines.en: Its tentacles are scorched by the flames, screaming in pain.

lines.zh: 它从高处摔下，发出刺耳的惨叫。
lines.en: It falls from above, emitting a piercing scream.

lines.zh: 它被水淹没，痛苦地挣扎着。
lines.en: It is submerged in water, struggling in pain.

lines.zh: 它被爆炸波及，发出痛苦的尖叫。
lines.en: It is hit by the explosion, emitting a painful scream.

lines.zh: 它的身体被箭矢射穿，痛苦地哀嚎。
lines.en: Its body is pierced by arrows, wailing in pain.

lines.zh: 它的身体被魔法击中，痛苦地扭曲。
lines.en: Its body is twisted in pain by magic.

lines.zh: 它虚弱地蜷缩一团，看起来快饿死了。
lines.en: It curls up weakly, looking close to starving to death.

lines.zh: 闪电击中它，痛苦地颤抖着。
lines.en: It shakes in pain from the lightning strike.

lines.zh: 它落入虚无，痛苦地扭曲变形。
lines.en: It warps in pain as it falls into the void.
